lines.translation: As Gurmukh, O my mind, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa nibahai chalai terai naal || rahaau ||
lines.translation: It shall stand by you always, and go with you. ||Pause||
The True Lord is the social status and honor of the Gurmukh.
Within the Gurmukh, is God, his friend and helper. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jis no aap kare so hoi ||
lines.translation: He alone becomes Gurmukh, whom the Lord so blesses.
He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with greatness. ||3||
The Gurmukh lives the True Word of the Shabad, and practices good deeds.
The Gurmukh, O Nanak, emancipates his family and relations. ||4||6||
Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਦਿ ਲਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa har saad lagee sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: My tongue is intuitively attracted to the taste of the Lord.
My mind is satisfied, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Lasting peace is obtained, contemplating the Shabad, the True Word of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane satagur vitahu sadaa balihaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru. ||1||Pause||
My eyes are content, lovingly focused on the One Lord.
My mind is content, having forsaken the love of duality. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: deh sareer sukh hovai sabad har naai ||
lines.translation: The frame of my body is at peace, through the Shabad, and the Name of the Lord.
The fragrance of the Naam permeates my heart. ||3||
O Nanak, one who has such great destiny written upon his forehead,
through the Bani of the Guru's Word, easily and intuitively becomes free of desire. ||4||7||
Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te naam paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: From the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained.
Through the Shabad, the True Word of God, one merges in the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man naam nidhaan too paai ||
lines.translation: O my soul, obtain the treasure of the Naam,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapane gur kee ma(n)n lai rajaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: by submitting to the Will of your Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad vichahu mail gavaai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, filth is washed away from within.
The Immaculate Naam comes to abide within the mind. ||2||
Deluded by doubt, the world wanders around.
It dies, and is born again, and is ruined by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se vadabhaagee jin har naam dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who meditate on the Name of the Lord.
By Guru's Grace, they enshrine the Name within their minds. ||4||8||
Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਵਿਰੋਧੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਇ ਨ ਵਸਹਿ ਇਕ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai naavai naal virodh hai dui na vasahi ik thaai ||
lines.translation: Ego is opposed to the Name of the Lord; the two do not dwell in the same place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vich sevaa na hovaee taa man birathaa jaai ||1||
lines.translation: In egotism, selfless service cannot be performed, and so the soul goes unfulfilled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har chet man mere too gur kaa sabad kamaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, think of the Lord, and practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam ma(n)nahi taa har milai taa vichahu haumai jaai || rahaau ||
lines.translation: If you submit to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then you shall meet with the Lord; only then will your ego depart from within. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਭੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai sabh sareer hai haumai opat hoi ||
lines.translation: Egotism is within all bodies; through egotism, we come to be born.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vadaa gubaar hai haumai vich bujh na sakai koi ||2||
lines.translation: Egotism is total darkness; in egotism, no one can understand anything. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vich bhagat na hovaee hukam na bujhiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: In egotism, devotional worship cannot be performed, and the Hukam of the Lord's Command cannot be understood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਬੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vich jeeu ba(n)dh hai naam na vasai man aai ||3||
lines.translation: In egotism, the soul is in bondage, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to abide in the mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satagur miliai haumai gaee taa sach vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, meeting with the True Guru, egotism is eliminated, and then, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach kamaavai sach rahai sache sev samaai ||4||9||12||
lines.translation: One starts practicing truth, abides in truth and by serving the True One gets absorbed in Him. ||4||9||12||
Wadahans, Fourth Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is one bed, and One Lord God.
The Gurmukh enjoys the Lord, the ocean of peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਣ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai prabh milan prem man aasaa ||
lines.translation: My mind longs to meet my Beloved Lord.
